behavior: Against a fixture symbol whose real reference count is exactly equal to the tool layer's configured cap (the boundary, neither above nor below it), java_references returns the full, untruncated list of that many references with `truncated` absent or false -- it is never reported as truncated when nothing was actually cut, and never off-by-one short of the true count.
rationale: Boundary sibling to TCON-TOOL-0004: comparing count >= cap instead of count > cap (or vice versa) passes the over-cap case but mislabels the exact-cap case as truncated, or drops the last legitimate reference -- an off-by-one an over-cap-only fixture can't catch. Same real-fixture reasoning as TCON-TOOL-0004 [INV-TOOL-3]. Falsifies a count > cap vs count >= cap boundary error in either direction.
